title: Be willing to
subtitle: 「願意……／樂意……／肯……」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「願意……／樂意……／肯……」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: 非常接近 be willing to，但通常比單純「願意」多一點「心理上或實際上已準備好」的意味。
words.example: We are prepared to discuss the issue further.
words.exampleZh: 我們願意進一步討論這個問題。

exercises.original: We are willing to discuss the issue further.
exercises.zh: 我們願意進一步討論這個問題。
exercises.upgrade: We are prepared to discuss the issue further.

options.explanation: 正式而自然，表示已願意並做好討論準備。
表示被迫做，和自願相反。

exercises.original: The company is willing to change the contract if necessary.
exercises.zh: 如有需要，公司願意修改合約。
exercises.upgrade: The company is prepared to change the contract if necessary.

options.explanation: 表示不太情願，意思不同。

exercises.original: She said she was willing to make some compromises.
exercises.zh: 她說她願意作出一些妥協。
exercises.upgrade: She said she was prepared to make some compromises.

words.note: 和 be prepared to 很接近，但通常更直接、更日常。
words.example: I'm ready to help if you need me.
words.exampleZh: 如果你需要，我願意幫忙。

exercises.original: I'm willing to help if you need me.
exercises.zh: 如果你需要，我願意幫忙。
exercises.upgrade: I'm ready to help if you need me.

options.explanation: 日常自然，表示已準備好採取行動。

exercises.original: The team is willing to start immediately.
exercises.zh: 團隊願意立即開始。
exercises.upgrade: The team is ready to start immediately.

options.explanation: immediately 強化「已準備好」的意思。

exercises.original: He is willing to speak whenever the chair asks him.
exercises.zh: 主席一叫到他，他就願意發言。
exercises.upgrade: He is ready to speak whenever the chair asks him.

words.note: 當 be willing to 已經進一步變成「正式或明確答應」時，agree to 很自然。
words.example: She agreed to stay late and finish the report.
words.exampleZh: 她答應留下來把報告完成。

exercises.original: She was willing to stay late and finish the report.
exercises.zh: 她答應留下來把報告完成。
exercises.upgrade: She agreed to stay late and finish the report.

options.explanation: 表示意願已進一步變成明確同意。

exercises.original: The landlord was willing to extend the deadline.
exercises.zh: 業主同意延長期限。
exercises.upgrade: The landlord agreed to extend the deadline.

exercises.original: After some discussion, they were willing to reduce the price.
exercises.zh: 經過討論後，他們同意降低價格。
exercises.upgrade: After some discussion, they agreed to reduce the price.

options.explanation: 討論後作出明確同意，很自然。

words.note: 很自然、友善，表示不只是願意，而且通常沒有勉強感。
words.example: I'd be happy to explain it again.

exercises.original: I'd be willing to explain the process again.
exercises.zh: 我很樂意再解釋一次流程。
exercises.upgrade: I'd be happy to explain the process again.

options.explanation: 友善且自然，表示樂意幫忙。

exercises.original: We would be willing to answer any further questions.
exercises.zh: 我們很樂意回答任何進一步問題。
exercises.upgrade: We would be happy to answer any further questions.

options.explanation: 客服／正式回覆中很常見。

exercises.original: I'm willing to give you a lift home.
exercises.zh: 我很樂意開車送你回家。
exercises.upgrade: I'm happy to give you a lift home.

words.note: 和 be happy to 很接近，語氣自然、友好。
words.example: I'd be glad to answer any questions.
words.exampleZh: 我很樂意回答任何問題。

exercises.original: I'd be willing to answer your questions.
exercises.zh: 我很樂意回答你的問題。
exercises.upgrade: I'd be glad to answer your questions.

options.explanation: 自然、有禮，和 happy to 很接近。

exercises.original: She said she would be willing to introduce us.
exercises.zh: 她說她很樂意介紹我們認識。
exercises.upgrade: She said she would be glad to introduce us.

exercises.original: We'd be willing to provide more details.
exercises.zh: 我們很樂意提供更多資料。
exercises.upgrade: We'd be glad to provide more details.

options.explanation: 正式回覆和服務語境都自然。

words.meaning: 對……持開放態度；願意考慮
words.note: 表示願意考慮某個想法、建議、改變或可能性。
words.example: The company is open to changing the schedule.
words.exampleZh: 公司願意考慮更改時間表。

exercises.original: The company is willing to consider changing the schedule.
exercises.zh: 公司願意考慮更改時間表。
exercises.upgrade: The company is open to changing the schedule.

exercises.original: I'm willing to hear other suggestions.
exercises.zh: 我願意聽取其他建議。
exercises.upgrade: I'm open to other suggestions.

options.explanation: open to suggestions 是固定自然搭配。

exercises.original: They are willing to try a different approach.
exercises.zh: 他們願意嘗試不同的方法。
exercises.upgrade: They are open to trying a different approach.

words.note: 表示某人有做某事的傾向或意願，但通常沒有 agree to 那麼確定。
words.example: I'm inclined to give the proposal another chance.
words.exampleZh: 我傾向於願意再給這個提案一次機會。

exercises.original: I'm willing to give the proposal another chance.
exercises.zh: 我傾向於願意再給這個提案一次機會。
exercises.upgrade: I'm inclined to give the proposal another chance.

options.explanation: 表示有做這件事的傾向，但未必已正式決定。

exercises.original: She seems willing to accept the revised offer.
exercises.zh: 她似乎傾向於接受修訂後的提議。
exercises.upgrade: She seems inclined to accept the revised offer.

exercises.original: He is willing to support the plan, although he has not decided yet.
exercises.zh: 雖然尚未決定，但他傾向於支持這個計劃。
exercises.upgrade: He is inclined to support the plan.

options.explanation: 原句說尚未決定，最適合用「傾向」。
表示更強的承諾，太確定。

words.note: 較正式、書面，表示某人有意願採取某種行動。
words.example: The committee is disposed to support the revised plan.
words.exampleZh: 委員會傾向於支持修訂後的計劃。

exercises.original: The committee is willing to support the revised plan.
exercises.zh: 委員會傾向於支持修訂後的計劃。
exercises.upgrade: The committee is disposed to support the revised plan.

options.explanation: 正式書面語，表示有意願／傾向支持。

exercises.original: The board appears willing to approve the proposal.
exercises.zh: 董事會似乎傾向於批准這個提案。
exercises.upgrade: The board appears disposed to approve the proposal.

exercises.original: Officials are willing to consider a temporary exemption.
exercises.zh: 官員願意考慮暫時豁免。
exercises.upgrade: Officials are disposed to consider a temporary exemption.

words.note: 較正式，表示明確同意某項行動、安排或程序。
words.example: She consented to take part in the study.

exercises.original: She was willing to take part in the study after reading the information sheet.
exercises.zh: 她閱讀資料說明後，同意參與研究。
exercises.upgrade: She consented to take part in the study.

options.explanation: 研究語境中表示正式同意。

exercises.original: The patient was willing to undergo the procedure.
exercises.zh: 病人同意接受該項程序。
exercises.upgrade: The patient consented to undergo the procedure.

options.explanation: 醫療語境中最自然、正式。

exercises.original: The owner was willing to allow the inspection.
exercises.zh: 業主同意進行檢查。
exercises.upgrade: The owner consented to the inspection.

words.note: 表示不只是願意，而是主動提出自己來做。
words.example: He volunteered to organize the event.
words.exampleZh: 他主動自願籌辦這個活動。

exercises.original: He was willing to organize the event without being asked.
exercises.zh: 沒有人要求，他主動自願籌辦活動。
exercises.upgrade: He volunteered to organize the event.

options.explanation: without being asked 明確表示主動自願。

exercises.original: She was willing to stay behind and help clean up.
exercises.zh: 她主動自願留下來幫忙清理。
exercises.upgrade: She volunteered to stay behind and help clean up.

exercises.original: Several students were willing to speak first.
exercises.zh: 幾名學生主動自願先發言。
exercises.upgrade: Several students volunteered to speak first.

options.explanation: 比一般 willingness 更積極。

words.note: 表示對某件事沒有反對，因此可以接受。
words.example: I have no objection to meeting earlier.

exercises.original: I'm willing to meet earlier if that is easier for you.
exercises.zh: 如果對你較方便，我不反對早一點見面。
exercises.upgrade: I have no objection to meeting earlier if that is easier for you.

options.explanation: 表示可以接受，語氣比「很樂意」弱。

exercises.original: She is willing to work from home on Fridays.
exercises.zh: 她不反對星期五在家工作。
exercises.upgrade: She has no objection to working from home on Fridays.

options.explanation: 表示不喜歡，不等於不反對。

exercises.original: They are willing to postpone the meeting by one day.
exercises.zh: 他們不反對把會議延遲一天。
exercises.upgrade: They have no objection to postponing the meeting by one day.

words.example: I don't mind waiting a little longer.

exercises.original: I'm willing to wait a little longer.
exercises.zh: 我不介意再等一會兒。
exercises.upgrade: I don't mind waiting a little longer.

options.explanation: 口語非常自然，後面要接 -ing。

exercises.original: She is willing to share a room.
exercises.zh: 她不介意和別人共用房間。
exercises.upgrade: She doesn't mind sharing a room.

exercises.original: We are willing to take the later train.
exercises.zh: 我們不介意乘較晚的火車。
exercises.upgrade: We don't mind taking the later train.

words.note: 較正式，表示願意接受建議、安排、改變或協商。
words.example: The landlord was amenable to extending the deadline.
words.exampleZh: 業主願意接受延長期限的安排。

exercises.original: The landlord is willing to extend the deadline.
exercises.zh: 業主願意接受延長期限的安排。
exercises.upgrade: The landlord is amenable to extending the deadline.

options.explanation: 正式協商語境中非常自然。

exercises.original: The team is willing to try a revised schedule.
exercises.zh: 團隊願意接受嘗試修訂後的時間表。
exercises.upgrade: The team is amenable to trying a revised schedule.

options.explanation: 表示願意配合／接受建議。

exercises.original: Both sides seem willing to compromise.
exercises.zh: 雙方似乎都願意接受妥協。
exercises.upgrade: Both sides seem amenable to compromise.

words.note: 口語常見，表示願意參與某件事或接受某個活動／挑戰。
words.example: Are you up for trying the new restaurant tonight?
words.exampleZh: 你今晚願不願意試試那家新餐廳？

exercises.original: Are you willing to try the new restaurant tonight?
exercises.zh: 你今晚願不願意試試那家新餐廳？
exercises.upgrade: Are you up for trying the new restaurant tonight?

options.explanation: 非常自然的口語表達，表示有興趣／願意參加。

exercises.original: I'm willing to go for a walk after dinner.
exercises.zh: 我晚餐後願意去散步。
exercises.upgrade: I'm up for going for a walk after dinner.

options.explanation: 社交／休閒邀請中很自然。

exercises.original: Would you be willing to join us for a game?
exercises.zh: 你願意和我們一起玩遊戲嗎？
exercises.upgrade: Would you be up for joining us for a game?

falseSynonyms.zh: 想做不一定等於願意做 want to 表示有慾望； be willing to 表示可以接受去做，即使未必很想。 我想去。 我願意去。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I want to go. I'm willing to go.

falseSynonyms.zh: 必須做不等於願意做 have to 表示義務；可能完全不情願。
有能力做不等於願意做 能力和意願是兩回事。
falseSynonyms.point: She is able to help. She is willing to help.

falseSynonyms.zh: 打算做不等於願意做 intend to 表示已有計劃／意圖； be willing to 只表示接受做這件事。
承諾比願意更強 promise to 表示明確承諾； be willing to 未必已作承諾。
接受不一定等於願意做 accept 可以接受一個提議、邀請或事實，但不一定和某個動作直接對應。
感興趣不等於願意行動 你可以對某件事感興趣，但未必願意真的去做。
詞性陷阱 - willing = 形容詞 - willingly = 副詞 - willingness = 名詞
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is willing to help. She willingly helped. Her willingness to help was appreciated.
